title: The Small Door
description: A quick succession of chamber apertures; a miniature journey rather than an overture.

title: Reed Exchange
description: Unequal answering choirs, long wind lines, keyboard interruptions and changing protagonists.

title: Fifths Under Glass
description: Walks through a graph of overlapping triads and sevenths; the same route changes register and color.

title: A Very Short Parade
description: Construction-tree endpoints become a moving instrumental genealogy, folding and unfolding.

title: Three Unequal Rivers
description: Three phrase clocks with changing rational relationships; broad currents and fast tributaries.

title: The Switches Are Singing
description: The sole amplitude-gate study: hard interlocks, ungated islands, variable duties and composite colors.

title: One Window Left Open
description: An intimate near-still miniature entirely within the destination field; a deliberate exception to the full journey.

title: Orchard of Circuits
description: A cue-driven instrumental network: phrase endings hand energy, register and contour to another player.

title: Thirty-Two Small Clocks
description: Endpoint identities persist while unequal rhythmic clocks activate different branches of the construction.

title: Rooms in a Long House
description: An episodic large form with returning rooms transformed by changing harmony, ensemble and temporal scale.

title: The Stair Remembers
description: Audible ascending and descending sequences through consonant chord subsets, with restrained mutations.

title: An Unfinished Atlas
description: A large additive/subtractive form: accumulate, clear, change direction, relocate, interrupt; a dry open-ended exit.
